federation: Academic & Student Welfare Federation · privacy subsystem

purposes.title: Consent purposes
purposes.subtitle: Registry of institutional consent boundaries.
purposes.versionIsolationBody: Publishing a scope change creates a new immutable version. Existing student authorisations are never retroactively widened.
purposes.boundRoleBody: Designated advisors formally assigned to active advisee cohorts. Access is restricted to assigned advisees only.
purposes.gracePeriodValue: Zero lag — immediate downstream read severing
purposes.coveredTypes: Covered attribute types (zero student data exposed)
purposes.excludedTitle: Strictly excluded from this purpose by policy
purposes.antiExpansionBody: Modifying a scope definition, a permitted attribute or a recipient role generates a new configuration version. Publishing a changed scope never silently expands grants already signed by students under the previous version; an expanded requirement must trigger an explicit affirmation request.
purposes.bilingualCaption: Plain-language descriptions shown directly to students when they evaluate a consent request.

policies.title: Access policies
policies.subtitle: Deterministic attribute-level decision rules: role × purpose × consent, evaluated jointly.
policies.superuserBody: Universal administrative wildcard reads on student attributes are categorically forbidden. No blanket database role overrides consent.
policies.inspectAuditsBody: Stream real-time policy gate evaluations and cryptographic proofs.

records.title: Access & processing records
records.subtitle: Every policy gate evaluation, permitted or refused, written to an immutable ledger.
records.correlationBody: Directly links the student portal revocation trigger to the advisor UI access denial within 134 ms.
records.zeroPayloadBody: No sensitive student data is stored in the audit trail. Evaluation happens against cryptographic schema tokens only; stored payload is 0 bytes (NULL).
records.exportGuaranteeBody: Export files contain strictly authorised processing metadata: timestamps, actor hashes, policy references, decision outcomes and correlation IDs. Student attribute values and sensitive payloads are never included.
records.interruptedBody: Ledger sync timed out. No partial file was created or staged.

erasure.title: Erasure queue & job ledger
erasure.subtitle: A student withdrawal enforces an instant cryptographic access block, followed by an asynchronous payload erasure job and a verification seal.
erasure.retentionBody: Completed jobs preserve the transactional ledger references while removing the protected payload's readability. Auditability is preserved without data retention.
erasure.zeroLagBody: Withdrawal triggers an architectural access block in 134 ms, so advisors receive zero bytes immediately while the purge executes in the queue.
erasure.failedBarBody: A failed job stays visible for authorised retry and never re-enables access. The access block remains strict regardless of worker errors.
erasure.metadataOnly: Policy: metadata-only display — zero decrypted payloads, zero key material.
erasure.drilldownHint: Selecting a job opens the verification drilldown.

verification.title: Erasure verification
verification.intro: Controlled cryptographic payload eradication for a student consent withdrawal. Bitemporal retention is enforced: protected payloads are destroyed while immutable advising case references and audit traces remain preserved.
verification.severedBody: Gateway access was cryptographically terminated within 134 ms of the student's revocation. Subsequent reads yield 0 bytes (null payload).
verification.isolationBody: Confirmed zero active secondary purpose grants. The attribute was bound solely to this purpose, so it is safe to purge without cross-purpose dependency conflicts.
verification.auditabilityBody: The advising case note and attendance evidence references remain intact. Only the underlying protected payload is shredded.
verification.subject: Subject / student ID
verification.dependencySubtitle: Verification that no other institutional purpose retains an active grant on this attribute.
verification.invariantBody: If an unresolved shared-purpose dependency existed — welfare holding an active grant for accommodation, for instance — the system enters a review-required quarantine state rather than guessing how to destroy data or inadvertently revoking legitimate coverage.
verification.attestationBody: Formal attestation that the preconditions are verified under Decree 13/2023.

emergency.title: Emergency access review
emergency.boundaryBody: Emergency overrides are evaluated strictly under proportionality, minimality and statutory necessity. A requisition requires authenticated steward attestation before an ephemeral gateway token can be minted. Permanent grants are programmatically forbidden.
emergency.supremacyBody: Lawfully shredded attributes cannot be restored, resurrected or bypassed by an emergency grant. The gateway returns permanent unavailability rather than minting fictitious decryption keys.
emergency.ledgerIntegrityBody: Bitemporal state snapshots verify zero in-memory residency leaks across federated compute clusters.
emergency.matrixTitle: Attribute scope evaluation & erasure supremacy matrix
emergency.matrixSubtitle: Zero raw payloads displayed — institutional metadata and cryptographic availability checks only.
